meaning_by_symbol.D/S/C/U: dim and still, silent, cold, unresponsive
meaning_by_symbol.H/D/R/Rg: hot all over, dim red, low rumble, rough or gritty
meaning_by_symbol.A/W/B/H: all faces blazing white, harsh buzz, heat
meaning_by_symbol.same: the action failed and the symptoms are the same
meaning_by_symbol.P1: apply tone to all six faces
meaning_by_symbol.P2: ring the bell on alternating opposite faces
meaning_by_symbol.P3: apply cloth to 2 adjacent edges, then ring the bell 3 times near the face
meaning_by_symbol.P4: warm 4 corners, then trace the edges
meaning_by_symbol.P5: place a warm stone beside each face
meaning_by_symbol.P6: apply cool cloth, then fan the start face and the opposite face
meaning_by_symbol.P7: use a dim lamp on the start face and a bright lamp on the opposite face
meaning_by_symbol.P8: place folded cloth on the face, then ring the bell at each edge twice
meaning_by_symbol.P9: for each corner of the start face in sequence, ring a brief bell, then warm that corner's 2 edges for the full duration at the round intensity
meaning_by_symbol.P10: place the board on the start face for the duration, then rotate and repeat on each face-pair
meaning_by_symbol.P11: ring the bell once at the center of each face starting from the start face, then place the warm stone beside the Veyru for the duration
meaning_by_symbol.P12: place the Veyru on a soft surface face-up, with moderate contact, and leave it undisturbed to rest
meaning_by_symbol.P13: apply cool cloth, then fan all 6 faces
meaning_by_symbol.P14: rotate for 12 seconds with a steady tone at the faces opposite the L face, then ring the bell at each corner once
meaning_by_symbol.LIMP: one-lamp impossible geometry for P7-type actions

reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry paradigm survives the evidence requirements. Although some symbols are suggestive on the surface, the codebook does not provide enough substitutional evidence with stable, compositional meaning contributions to justify segmentation. In particular: (1) P1–P14 fail the opaque-index test, since the numerals do not contribute literal count meanings but instead select unrelated procedures; (2) the apparent shared suffix /H is not supported by a substitution contrast in a common frame; both attested /H forms have unrelated preceding material and no contrasting filler in that slot; (3) D/S/C/U is compositionally suggestive because D, S, C, and U exist as standalone meanings, but there is no broader paradigm with demonstrated slot-wise substitution across multiple codes, and promoting slash-delimited symptom lists to a construction would require inventing classes and separator behavior not supported elsewhere; (4) F20g has no paradigm support for any internal slot. Because the instructions prefer a flat lexicon over false morphology, all symbols are treated as lexical.
